_note: Frames under the player on /work/al-doroub (bin-build-work-pages.py). Rows as hung on a wide screen, read in order; each frame is a still in assets/frames/al-doroub/ (<still>-640|1280-<md5[:8]>.jpg|.webp) and t, the second of the film it is from (a press plays from that second, rounded down). size: its share of the row; dy: how far above (-) or below (+) the line it hangs, px; depth: 1 for the one in focus at rest (exactly one), less for the planes behind it (the scroll moves them). pad: the row's inset, left and right, %. Phones: built from the same order.
